CHANNEL_API_URL.description: The base URL of GitHub's REST API; for GitHub Enterprise Server https://<host>/api/v3.

CHANNEL_TOKEN.description: A GitHub token of the bot's user that may read and write the comments of pull requests. Required by every command.

CHANNEL_SIGNING_SECRET.description: The secret of the webhook that sends issue_comment events. receive refuses a delivery whose X-Hub-Signature-256 does not match.
